data.name: Totem Empathy (Ex and Sp)
data.description: The totemic skald can improve the attitude of animals of the same type as his totem. This ability functions just like a Diplomacy check to improve the attitude of a person. The skald rolls 1d20 and adds his skald level and his Charisma modifier to determine the totem empathy check result. The typical domestic animal has a starting attitude of indifferent, while wild animals are usually unfriendly. In addition, the totemic skald can cast charm animal as a spell-like ability. This only functions against animals that are of the same type as his totem animal (subject to GM discretion).
